rv.q: Thankfully, the visuals are undoubtedly the show's biggest strengths.
Back to the Future: The Musical may be one of (if not THE) most visually interesting and innovative shows I've ever attended.
This production is not only packed with technical thrills and laughter, but also optimism and heart.
It's a big amusement park show and like I said sometimes that's all I need.
Taken as a standalone musical, it's living squarely in the past. The original songs are slight and unmemorable.

cn.t: Critics praise "Back to the Future: The Musical" as entertaining spectacle that successfully adapts the beloved film, with standout technical effects and nostalgic appeal that delights both fans and theatergoers.
